title: Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Claims Schedule: Damage to the Home
content:
For damage to the customer's home in the course of a Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery, each service level sets the number of hours after delivery within which the damage must be reported, the maximum compensation for damage to the home, and the number of business days in which a delivery claim is resolved.

## Schedule

| Service level | Hours after delivery within which damage to the home must be reported | Maximum compensation for damage to the home | Business days to resolve a delivery claim |
|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Delivery | 48 | Not applicable | 10 |
| Threshold Delivery | 48 | $500.00 | 10 |
| Room of Choice Delivery | 48 | $1,000.00 | 10 |
| White Glove Delivery | 48 | $2,500.00 | 10 |
| White Glove Delivery with Assembly | 48 | $2,500.00 | 10 |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away | 48 | $5,000.00 | 10 |

## Notes to the schedule

- The reporting period is 48 hours after delivery and the resolution period 10 business days at every level.
- The maximum compensation is in US dollars to the cent: 500, 1000, 2500, 2500 and 5000 dollars from Threshold Delivery upward. Curbside Delivery has no maximum compensation amount; its entry is not applicable.

## Illustrations (hypothetical claims)

| Level | Assessed damage to the home | Compensation limit | Compensation up to the limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Threshold Delivery | $350.00 | $500.00 | Up to $350.00 |
| Threshold Delivery | $800.00 | $500.00 | Up to $500.00 |
| White Glove Delivery | $3,000.00 | $2,500.00 | Up to $2,500.00 |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away | $3,000.00 | $5,000.00 | Up to $3,000.00 |
